The '''Derik'hur Highlands''' were a region on the [[Double Worlds|Twin World]] of [[Talus/Legends|Talus]].<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Derik'hur Highlands are one of many designated planetary regions in the [[Wikipedia:MMORPG|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.<ref name="SWG" />
